name: Skin editor
author: Brett
description: Token registry and Skin editor. The registry lists every --fx-* token in the system (element, area, state, light/dark, level, plain-English description, default, source), browsable and searchable. The Skin editor takes any UI you pick (a screen, dialog, plugin or element, from the list or by clicking it on screen) and draws it in a sandbox with real components; every edit hot-renders the preview, takes a snapshot, and the chain of snapshots reads like disk snapshots you can revert to at any point. Export the current state as a new skin at any time. Token list from the registry with Basic / Pro / Advanced views. Full API: REST, MCP, CLI and voice.

items.title: List the token registry
items.description: Every token with element, area, state, scheme, level, description, default and source. Filters: q, area, element, level, state, scheme, source.

items.title: Token registry summary
items.description: Counts by element, area, level and state.

items.title: One registry token
items.description: The entry for one --fx-* token.

items.title: UIs the Skin editor can sandbox
items.description: Screens, dialogs and plugins from the manifests, plus the element gallery.

items.title: Skin editor state
items.description: The picked UI, its head snapshot, the edited tokens and when it last changed.

items.title: List skin sessions
items.description: One session per picked UI: head, snapshot count, last change.

items.title: One skin session
items.description: The snapshot chain (rows like disk snapshots), the head and its state.

items.title: One skin snapshot
items.description: A snapshot of a UI's skin chain (an id, 'head' or 'default'): when, who or what made it, exactly which tokens it changed (old → new) and its full state, which is what a preview draws.

items.title: Compare two skin snapshots
items.description: Every token that differs between snapshot A and snapshot B (ids, 'head' or 'default'): A's value → B's, null = the default skin's.

items.title: Edit tokens
items.description: Set one or more tokens on the picked UI; the edit becomes a snapshot.

items.title: Revert to a snapshot
items.description: Revert to a snapshot id, to the default, or to how it was some minutes ago; the revert is itself a snapshot.

items.title: Undo the last edit
items.description: Restore previous edit (same as restore with to: previous).

items.title: Restore previous edit / Restore from axHub
items.description: to: previous = the state before the last change (a second one redoes); to: hub = the default skin, no token edits (the look axHub shares). Either is a new snapshot, so nothing is lost.

items.title: Export as a new skin
items.description: Export a snapshot (default the head) as a brand-new skin: name (id from it unless given), description, a thumbnail drawn in the skin's own values, saved to the plugin's skin library and queued for the axHub skin library (hub: false skips it). The default skin's id is locked.

items.title: Pick a UI
items.description: Make this UI the current one (its session starts at the default skin when new).

items.title: Exported skins
items.description: The built-in default skin (locked: never edited, overwritten or deleted; every chain starts there) first, then every skin exported from the Skin editor.

items.title: One exported skin
items.description: Read one exported skin by its id. "default" returns the built-in default skin over the console's own look.

items.title: Delete an exported skin
items.description: Delete one exported skin. Asks for a confirm first. The default skin is locked (409).

items.title: axHub skin library queue
items.description: Where exported skins go on axHub (project, folder, table) and each one's state: queued, sent, or failed with the error. An open console page sends the queue with its hub session.

items.title: Send a skin to the axHub library
items.description: Queue an exported skin (again) for the axHub skin library.

items.title: Report an axHub send
items.description: Used by the console page after it sent a queued skin: {ok} or {ok: false, error}.

items.title: Say it
items.description: A spoken phrase → the Skin editor action it means, run: 'revert the skin to 10 minutes ago', 'export this as a new skin called Midnight', 'set the accent to #ff8800 in the skin', 'search the token registry for hover'.
